gloss: day by day; more and more each day

definitions.gloss: day by day; increasingly with each day
definitions.explanation: Describes a change that becomes more marked from one day to the next. Most often an increase (colder, stronger, more anxious), but also a decline that keeps deepening.

examples.japanese: {日増|ひま}しに⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It gets colder day by day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日増|ひま}しに⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧いった。
examples.english: My anxiety grew stronger day by day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退院|たいいん}して→退院する：01847_taiinsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日増|ひま}しに⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}している→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: Since leaving the hospital, my grandmother has been getting her strength back more each day.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually with a verb or adjective of increase: ⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧, ⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧, ⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧, ⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧. A steadily deepening decline also works (⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日増|ひま}しに⟦{衰|おとろ}える→衰える：04584_otoroeru⟧). It sounds a little more written than ⟦{日|ひ}に{日|ひ}に→日に日に：34046_hinihini⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日増|ひま}しに⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ / ⟦{暖|あたた}かく→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get colder / warmer day by day
- {日増|ひま}しに⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧: to mount day by day (tension, expectations)
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日増|ひま}しに⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: anxiety grows every day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日|ひ}に{日|ひ}に→日に日に：34046_hinihini⟧: day by day (the everyday word)
- ⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually (no sense of day-by-day steps)
